headline: LeviLauncher Hotfix
summary: This update improves the External Mods catalog with V2 support and better newest-release sorting.

items.text: Added V2 external mod catalog support with automatic release metadata and multiple download assets.
items.headline: LeviLauncher v1.6.0
items.summary: Added Minecraft 26.60 support, launcher HUD controls, new world tools, and numerous optimisations.

items.text: Added an option to hide the launcher HUD and overlay buttons.
Added a world map and advanced NBT editing.
Fixed external mods sorting so newly updated mods appear first when sorting by newest.
Fixed the options editor not working.
